title: Ring Triceps Extension
summary: A bodyweight triceps extension on rings with your arms overhead, which loads the long head in a stretched position.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for triceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.2 for abs: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly abs total.

setup.text: Hold the rings at chest height and lean forward with your arms straight.
Bend your elbows so your forehead moves toward the rings.
Push back out to straight arms.

form_cues.cue: Bend the elbows to bring your head between your hands
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your body rigid.

mistakes.text: Letting the hips sag as you push back.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
